title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions on Israeli sport, from a Beijing windsurfing bronze to this week's European football and swimming action.

questions.question: What color medal did Shahar Zubari win in the men's RS:X windsurfing event at the 2008 Beijing Olympics?
questions.explanation: Zubari finished with 58 net points to take bronze behind New Zealand's Tom Ashley and France's Julien Bontemps, Israel's only medal at the Beijing Games.

questions.question: Which Italian club will Hapoel Tel Aviv face in the Conference League playoff round after eliminating Katowice?
questions.explanation: Hapoel Tel Aviv advanced 3-2 on aggregate over Katowice and will meet 2024 Europa League champions Atalanta, with the first leg in Bergamo on August 20.

questions.question: Where was the first leg of Beitar Jerusalem's Conference League tie against Austria Wien played, with Beitar now trailing 2-1 on aggregate?
questions.explanation: The first leg was staged at a neutral venue, Ilie Oană Stadium in Ploiești, where Austria Wien came from behind to win 2-1.

questions.question: Alongside Hapoel Bat Yam, which US university does European Championships swimmer Daria Golovaty represent?
questions.explanation: Golovaty, who has held Israeli citizenship since 2006, swims for Hapoel Bat Yam and the University of Louisville and just missed the 200m freestyle final in Paris.

questions.question: Which Olympic Games did new Maccabi Haifa loan goalkeeper Omer Niraon represent Israel at?
questions.explanation: Niraon, who joins Maccabi Haifa on loan from Maccabi Netanya as back-up to Omri Glazer, played in goal for Israel at the 2024 Paris Olympics.
